title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
statement: `numbers` is sorted in nondecreasing order. Find two different indices whose values sum to `target`. Return those indices as 1-based positions `[index1, index2]` with index1 < index2. Exactly one solution exists.
hints: Because the array is sorted, moving the right pointer left decreases the sum and moving the left pointer right increases it.
Start with the first and last positions.

approaches.name: Binary search each complement
approaches.explanation: For each left value, binary-search the partner to its right.

approaches.name: Opposite pointers
approaches.explanation: Shrink the interval from both ends.

editorial: Place one pointer at each end. If the sum is too small, the left value is too small, so advance the left pointer. If the sum is too large, retreat the right pointer. The sorted order makes each decision safe, and each pointer moves at most n times.
